title.zh: 将邦阿西楠省巴亚姆邦市镇马南邦社区学校的名称变更为Asuncion P. Guevara社区学校的法案
title.en: An Act to Change the Name of the Manambong Community School in the Municipality of Bayambang, Province of Pangasinan, to Asuncion P. Guevara Community School
title.orig: An Act to Change the Name of the Manambong Community School in the Municipality of Bayambang, Province of Pangasinan, to Asuncion P. Guevara Community School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2173_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Manambong Community School in the Municipality of Bayambang, Province of Pangasinan, is hereby changed to Asuncion P. Guevara Community School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 26, 1959.
